diagram_previews.alt: A 5 by 5 grid of unit squares cut by a thick staircase line. The 15 squares on and below the staircase are blue (columns of heights 1 to 5, labelled 1+2+3+4+5) and the 10 squares above it are pink (rows of lengths 1 to 4, labelled 1+2+3+4); both sides of the square are labelled 5.
